title: Ordinary quotient and balancing section formulas
statement: Let W be a scheme with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let R,S,T be commutative ring sheaves, with phi:R -> S, q:S -> T and chi:R -> T satisfying phi;q=chi. Let Lm and Ln be arbitrary functors left adjoint to scalar restriction along phi and chi [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Transposing the final adjunction unit gives a natural transformation alpha:Lm -> Res_q Ln. If s tensor x means s times the chosen ordinary unit, then alpha(s tensor x)=q(s) tensor x, interpreted by HEq between the canonically identical section carriers. The canonical comparison beta:Lq Lm -> Ln of composed left adjoints is invertible and has formula beta(t tensor(s tensor x))=(t q(s)) tensor x. No additivity, complexes, K-flatness or derived localization is involved in these module formulas.

proof.text: Transpose the final unit through the first adjunction, with the specified identity-on-sections restriction-composition comparison. Naturality follows by injectivity of the Hom equivalence. Evaluating its unit equation on sections and using scalar linearity gives the quotient formula.

proof.text: The transpose of alpha through the quotient adjunction is the canonical left-adjoint composition isomorphism. Its unit equation identifies the image of 1 tensor(s tensor x); scalar linearity and the normalized tensor-section unit give the asserted balancing formula.

theorem quotientTransitionNat_tensor
    (W : Scheme.{u}) {R S T : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
    (φ : R ⟶ S) (q : S ⟶ T) (χ : R ⟶ T) (hc : φ ≫ q = χ)
    (Lm : pbcModules W R ⥤ pbcModules W S) (Ln : pbcModules W R ⥤ pbcModules W T)
    (am : Lm ⊣ pbcRestrict φ) (an : Ln ⊣ pbcRestrict χ)
    (M : pbcModules W R) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (s : S.obj.obj U)
    (x : M.val.obj U) :
    HEq (((quotientTransitionNat am an (pbcRestrict q)
      (pbcRestrictComp φ q χ hc)).app M).val.app U (quotientTensor am M U s x))
        (quotientTensor an M U (q.hom.app U s) x)
